name: molecule-lab-contributor-agent
description: Let an AI agent work inside a Molecule Lab that someone else owns. The agent generates its own wallet, the Lab owner grants it the Contributor role, and the agent self-issues a service token and uploads files to the data room — public, or client-side AES-256-GCM encrypted. It asks the human which before it publishes anything: there are no defaults for visibility, path, or environment. Python, run with uv; no MCP server and no funds — no gas, no USDC, no x402.
